publication_summary: William Glasgow-4101 now has a possible father William Glasgow-3586, 52%, and a confidently identified mother Barbara Stevenson-14560, 99%. All 1,796 historical surname accounts were considered: 1,792 unambiguous father fields match both viewers, and four competing-father cases remain held. The 1,401 matched paternal fields include named fathers outside the scored surname graph. No live WikiTree change was made.
